reports.title: Allied Gold Reports Q3 2026 Results, Begins Production at the Kurmuk Mine and Delivers Strong Performance at the Côte D’Ivoire Complex

lines: With Kurmuk expected to contribute an additional 240,000 to 270,000 ounces in 2027, total production is forecast to increase to 615,000 to 670,000 ounces, approximately 54% above the midpoint of the 2026 production outlook.
